worldcombat.skill.fly.summary: Leap out of melee reach into open sky, hover a beat, then drop: a contact hit that presses the target down and shoves it back. Aim at a foe (tracking follows the configuration) or at an empty spot for a wider pinned drop that can press a whole group. The headroom above decides the real height - open sky gives the full drop, while a roof or cave forces a low hop whose hit and telegraph shrink together; a pinned drop onto open ground does not fake an explosion. Ground melee cannot reach the hover, but ranged attacks can.
worldcombat.skill.fly.use.0: Skip the melee and drop from above
worldcombat.skill.fly.use.1: Cross low walls, ditches and crowds
worldcombat.skill.fly.use.2: Claim a high landing before cover arrives
worldcombat.skill.fly.description.0: The drop deals %1$s contact damage and presses the target down and back.
worldcombat.skill.fly.description.1: Climb at %2$s blocks/tick to about %1$s blocks up, then hover and fall.
worldcombat.skill.fly.description.2: Hovers for %1$s ticks; the landing check is based on %2$s blocks (narrower for a tracked dive, wider for a pinned drop), pressing the target down about %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fly.description.3: The headroom above at the moment of casting sets the real height: open sky gives the full drop and the heaviest hit; a roof, cave or canopy forces a low hop under the ceiling, where the hit is at most a bit over half as heavy. The height actually reached floats up on landing, and the damage is computed from it.
worldcombat.skill.fly.description.4: While hovering, ground melee cannot reach the user, but ranged attacks can; the target can reposition in that window, or duck under cover that blocks the descent line. The hover carries a visible Airborne status that counts the user as airborne, which other moves and companions read.
worldcombat.skill.fly.stance.track: Tracked dive: the landing follows the target's live position while hovering - a narrow, single spot that pins a mover.
worldcombat.skill.fly.stance.pin: Pinned drop: the landing is locked at cast with nearly twice the radius, pressing up to %1$s foes at once (farther from the landing means a lighter blow) - but a target that walks out escapes, and recovery and cooldown are longer.
worldcombat.skill.fly.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds it spends %4$s PP, then recovers for %3$s seconds with a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.fly.growth.0: From level 32 the drop power climbs another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.fly.growth.1: From level 48 it climbs one more step.
worldcombat.skill.fly.preference.track.h: On (tracked dive): the landing follows the target's live position while hovering - a narrow, single spot that pins a mover. Off (pinned drop): the landing is locked at cast with nearly twice the radius, pressing a whole group, but a target that walks out escapes and recovery and cooldown are longer.
worldcombat.skill.fly.preference.ai.maxC: How far a foe may be before the companion considers Fly; lower keeps it close, higher lets it fly out farther.
worldcombat.skill.fly.preference.ai.minH: The companion treats Fly as an escape strike below this HP fraction, moving it up the order; higher makes it fly more often when hurt.
worldcombat.skill.fly.preference.ai.crow: In a pinned drop, only fly when at least this many foes cluster near the landing, so one drop presses a group; a tracked dive ignores this, and 1 means a lone target is enough.
worldcombat.skill.fly.preference.ai.leav: When on, a companion on hold will leave its post to fly out and drop on a foe.
